facts.fact: The OTR says individual taxpayers can now create or recover their tax identification number (NIF) online at nif.otr.tg, presented 18 December 2023.
OTR says individuals can create a NIF particulier online at nif.otr.tg or at tax offices, the platform also searching existing NIFs and issuing a registration sheet.
OTR says article 7 of the tax procedures book requires one unique NIF per taxpayer, and the individual NIF is required for customs clearance of personal goods and for property registration.

note: Online registration needs a national ID card or passport, but no check against the national ID register is stated.

facts.fact: OTR launched nif.otr.tg, letting individuals with a valid national ID card or Togolese passport create their tax registration number (NIF) online.
OTR says entering an identity document number and birth date makes the system detect whether the person already holds a NIF.

note: The document says nothing about a taxpayer register.
